claim: A standard evening desert safari with BBQ dinner starts around AED 210 (USD 57); adding red-dune bashing, 35-min quad-bike ride and Al Khayma Camp raises it to AED 499 (USD 136) per person.
quote: A regular safari with BBQ dinner costs from AED 210 ($57)... if you want to include Red Dunes Bashing, a 35-minute Quad Bike Ride, and Al Khayma Camp, the price goes up to AED 499 ($136) per person.

claim: Shared evening desert safaris start near AED 99-129 per adult including dune bashing, camel rides, sandboarding, BBQ dinner and live shows; overnight safaris run around AED 349 with camping and breakfast.
quote: shared evening desert safaris in Dubai start from around AED 99 per adult, typically including thrilling dune bashing, camel rides, sandboarding, BBQ dinner, and live entertainment... overnight safaris cost around AED 349 per person, including camping, stargazing, and breakfast.

claim: Skydive Dubai tandem jumps over the Palm Jumeirah drop zone cost roughly AED 2,000-2,200 (USD 545-730 range), with standard video packages 400-475 AED and premium outside-videographer footage 715-845 AED.
quote: Palm Jumeirah tandem jumps cost 2,000-2,200 AED... Video packages range from 400-475 AED for standard video to 715-845 AED for premium outside videographer services.

claim: Booking platforms list the Palm Jumeirah tandem skydive at roughly AED 2,199-2,749 depending on platform and season.
quote: around AED 2,599 for a tandem skydive over Palm Jumeirah... One booking platform lists AED 2,749.00... A standard tandem jump typically costs between AED 2,199 and AED 2,400 per person

claim: Balloon Adventures Dubai (Hero Balloon Flights) offers a sunrise hot-air balloon ride with an in-flight falcon show and a breakfast menu curated by a Michelin-starred chef.
quote: Balloon Adventures Dubai offers an in-flight falcon performance and a breakfast menu curated by a Michelin-starred Chef.

claim: Hot-air balloon packages start around AED 649; deluxe tier (~AED 1,100-1,500) adds a 40-60 minute flight, in-flight falcon show, and buffet breakfast, with flights reaching up to 4,000 ft at sunrise.
quote: Packages start from approximately 649 AED... the deluxe package includes 40-60 minutes balloon ride... in-flight falcon show, and buffet breakfast in camp... reaching altitudes up to 4,000 feet

claim: XLine Dubai Marina is the world's longest urban zipline at ~1 km, launching from 170 m and hitting up to 80 km/h, with riders flying head-first in a Superman position over Marina bay.
quote: XLine Dubai Marina is the world's longest urban zipline. With average speed of 80km/h, this up to 170m high and 1km long zipline... A person is positioned head first in the Superman position

claim: XLine prices run roughly AED 500-700 solo (youth 12-16 ~AED 499, adult ~AED 699), tandem ~AED 1,200; riders must be 12-65, 45-100 kg, taller than 130 cm and wear closed shoes.
quote: Youth (12-16): 499 AED and adults: 699 AED... a tandem zipline... costs AED 1200... Riders must be between 12 and 65 years old, weighing between 45 kg and 100 kg, and taller than 130 cm

claim: Self-drive dune buggy tours range from AED 399 up to AED 1,499; a 1-hour 2-seater Polaris RZR ~AED 900, 4-seater ~AED 1,200, Can-Am Maverick X3 ~AED 1,500, with no driving licence required.
quote: Dune buggy prices in Dubai start from AED 399 to AED 1,499... A 1-hour dune buggy ride starts from 900 AED for a 2-seater Polaris RZR, with the 4-seater version at 1,200 AED... For a Can-Am Maverick X3, the 1-hour ride is 1,500 AED

claim: Operators provide self-drive buggy tours of 30-60 minutes including helmet/goggles/gloves, full safety briefing and training, a guide, and water, using Polaris RZR and Can-Am Maverick vehicles.
quote: expert guides provide a full safety briefing and basic training... The price includes the buggy rental, safety gear (helmet, goggles, gloves), safety briefing and training, a professional guide, and water.
